candidates.violated_requirement: Gray-to-binary conversion should use XOR operations to correctly decode the Gray code. Replacing XOR with OR will cause incorrect binary values to be generated, leading to wrong Gray code outputs.
candidates.spec_basis: The specification requires correct Gray code to binary conversion using XOR operations.

candidates.violated_requirement: Gray-to-binary conversion requires XOR operations between adjacent bits. Using AND instead will produce incorrect binary values, affecting the final Gray code output.
candidates.spec_basis: The specification requires correct Gray code to binary conversion using XOR operations.

candidates.violated_requirement: The binary increment step should add 1 to the binary value. Replacing this with adding 0 will prevent the counter from advancing, causing it to stay at the initial Gray code value.
candidates.spec_basis: The specification requires incrementing the binary value by 1 in the counting process.

candidates.violated_requirement: Binary-to-Gray conversion requires shifting right by 1 and XORing with the original value. Shifting by 2 instead will produce incorrect Gray code values that don't follow the single-bit change property.
candidates.spec_basis: The specification requires correct binary to Gray code conversion using (value >> 1) ^ value.
